text: I read a spec's plan.md for dispositions naming design_review rounds, found none, and concluded the design rounds filed no rows — the ground under a law change and two conclusions sent to a peer. A disposition names the round that closed a row, not the round that filed it, and that spec's convention wrote closures as review rN. Reproduced properly by walking the nineteen commits that touched spec.md: blocking rows grow by exactly the round's [cb] each time, 4 8 13 18 20 22 24 25 26 27 30 31, every one carrying a citation and a disposition. The peer built two proposals and an operator report on my error before measuring it themselves; the correction cost three exchanges
